published.source: Paladin PR (rotation audit pass 23: Hammer of Wrath above Consecration, 2026-10-16)

summary: The twist build with its side points in Holy instead of Precision.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -3s, Seal of Command at -1.5s so the first swing gets the Echo
Hammer of Wrath below 20% health, ahead of Consecration
Consecration on cooldown while mana is at or above 20%
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Command whenever no damage seal is up

Twist: with Seal of Command up, swap to Seal of Righteousness in the last 1.5s before a swing, and back to Command before the next swing (one swap per swing, down to 20% mana); Twist of Light's Echo applies the old seal on the next swing
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: 0.6% behind the default at 120s and 0.9% at 300s (no Precision).
Purifying Power does nothing on the generic boss.
Holy Strike's flat bonus is inside the weapon percent (client data). Unconfirmed on the beta.
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% at stake).
Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power a hit with a two-hander, once (70425 tooltip). Counted twice it would be 46-51 DPS higher. At the proc spell's 0 it would be 53-59 lower.
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization boosts Holy seal damage (Era sim choice, the client says Physical only). Without it: -11.
notes: mksettings writes primarySeal Righteousness; set to Command to match the shipped preset's options (the APL never uses Cast Primary Seal, so DPS is unaffected).
